description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
